name: Seinarukana Gaiden - Seirei Tenshou ~Crystal Friends~
original_name: 聖なるかな外伝・精霊天翔 ～Crystal Friends～
source:
This is the fandisc to Seirei Tenshou and is an ADV/STG just like the original, but with more ichaicha episodes. The game consists of 40 short stories featuring many alternate scenarios that might have occurred. In the STG parts, you can now play as Liolina and Liliana (with frying pan as a weapon).

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《精靈天翔》的Fan Disc，與原作一樣結合冒險和射擊玩法，但增加了更多甜蜜親密的情節。遊戲由40篇短篇故事組成，描寫多種原本可能發生的平行情節。射擊部分現在可以操控莉歐莉娜和莉莉安娜，後者會使用平底鍋作武器。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
